title: Incorrect early return in parse_cookie
detail: The code returns an empty ImmutableMultiDict when a cookie header is present, skipping the parsing loop. It should return an empty dict only when no cookie header is provided.
note: Describes the planted negation: a cookie header that is present parses to nothing.

title: Passing unsupported kwarg to http.parse_cookie
detail: The legacy 'cls' kwarg is still forwarded to http.parse_cookie, which does not accept it, leading to a TypeError when callers pass 'cls'.

title: Inverted file pointer check
detail: The condition now skips processing when fp is not None, which means all file objects are ignored and the function will never read any file data. The original code correctly skipped only when fp is None.
